title: Price With Tax
statement:
Show what each product costs at the register once 8% sales tax is added.

The `products` table has these columns:

- `id`: the product's id, a whole number
- `name`: the product's name
- `price`: the price before tax in dollars, with 2 decimals

Return two columns: `name`, and `price_with_tax`, which is the price plus 8% tax, rounded to 2 decimals. Return one row per product, ordered by `id`.

Expected output:

```text
      name      | price_with_tax
----------------+----------------
 Desk Lamp      |          37.79
 Wireless Mouse |          26.46
 Coffee Mug     |          10.75
 Yoga Mat       |          31.32
 Notebook       |           4.59
(5 rows)
```
setup:
CREATE TABLE products (
  id INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  price NUMERIC(8, 2) NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO products (name, price) VALUES
  ('Desk Lamp', 34.99),
  ('Wireless Mouse', 24.50),
  ('Coffee Mug', 9.95),
  ('Yoga Mat', 29.00),
  ('Notebook', 4.25);

tests.output:
name      | price_with_tax
----------------+----------------
 Desk Lamp      |          37.79
 Wireless Mouse |          26.46
 Coffee Mug     |          10.75
 Yoga Mat       |          31.32
 Notebook       |           4.59
(5 rows)

tests.stdin: INSERT INTO products (name, price) VALUES ('Gift Card', 0.00), ('Standing Desk', 499.99);
tests.output:
name      | price_with_tax
----------------+----------------
 Desk Lamp      |          37.79
 Wireless Mouse |          26.46
 Coffee Mug     |          10.75
 Yoga Mat       |          31.32
 Notebook       |           4.59
 Gift Card      |           0.00
 Standing Desk  |         539.99
(7 rows)

tests.stdin:
UPDATE products SET price = 0.10 WHERE name = 'Notebook';
UPDATE products SET price = 100.00 WHERE name = 'Desk Lamp';
tests.output:
name      | price_with_tax
----------------+----------------
 Desk Lamp      |         108.00
 Wireless Mouse |          26.46
 Coffee Mug     |          10.75
 Yoga Mat       |          31.32
 Notebook       |           0.11
(5 rows)

tests.stdin:
DELETE FROM products WHERE name <> 'Coffee Mug';
INSERT INTO products (name, price) VALUES ('Phone Case', 12.49);
tests.output:
name    | price_with_tax
------------+----------------
 Coffee Mug |          10.75
 Phone Case |          13.49
(2 rows)

hints: Adding 8% tax is the same as multiplying the price by 1.08.
`ROUND(value, 2)` keeps 2 decimals. Name the new column with `AS`.

sql.starter:
-- TODO: add 8% tax to the price and round it to 2 decimals
SELECT name, price AS price_with_tax
FROM products
ORDER BY id;
